```python
def solve(case):
    payload = case.get("payload", case)  # handle both wrapped and unwrapped
    
    nodes = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for node in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing required field: {field}")
    
    # Build structure
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    
    # Build children map
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    root_id = None
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is None:
            root_id = n["id"]
        else:
            if n["parent"] not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent {n['parent']} not found for node {n['id']}")
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    if root_id is None:
        raise ValueError("No root node found")
    
    # retained set
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removal_order = []
    
    # Sort candidates: depth descending, then node ID ascending (stable tie-break)
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip if symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        
        # Skip if has retained children
        has_retained_child = any(child in retained for child in children[nid])
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        
        # Tentatively remove: check if all required symbols remain
        retained.discard(nid)
        
        # Check required symbols still represented
        symbols_in_retained = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)
        
        if all(sym in symbols_in_retained for sym in required_symbols):
            # Keep removal
            removal_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Restore
            retained.add(nid)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```

```python
def solve(case):
    # Extract payload (handle both wrapped and unwrapped inputs)
    if "payload" in case:
        payload = case["payload"]
    else:
        payload = case

    # Validate required top-level fields
    for field in ("nodes", "required_symbols"):
        if field not in payload:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required field in payload: {field}")

    nodes = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])

    if not isinstance(nodes, list) or len(nodes) == 0:
        raise ValueError("'nodes' must be a non-empty list")

    # Validate each node
    required_node_fields = ("id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility")
    for node in nodes:
        for field in required_node_fields:
            if field not in node:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing required field '{field}': {node}")

    # Build lookup structures
    node_map = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        if nid in node_map:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate node id: {nid}")
        node_map[nid] = node

    # Build parent->children map
    children = {nid: [] for nid in node_map}
    root_id = None
    for node in nodes:
        if node["parent"] is None:
            if root_id is not None:
                raise ValueError("Multiple root nodes found")
            root_id = node["id"]
        else:
            parent_id = node["parent"]
            if parent_id not in node_map:
                raise ValueError(f"Parent '{parent_id}' not found for node '{node['id']}'")
            children[parent_id].append(node["id"])

    if root_id is None:
        raise ValueError("No root node found (no node with parent=null)")

    # Validate required symbols are present in the tree initially
    symbols_in_tree = set(n["symbol"] for n in nodes)
    for sym in required_symbols:
        if sym not in symbols_in_tree:
            raise ValueError(f"Required symbol '{sym}' not present in tree")

    # Initialize retained set
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removal_order = []

    # Sort candidates: deeper first, then by node ID (lexicographic) as stable tie-break
    candidates = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))

    for node in candidates:
        nid = node["id"]

        # Never remove non-removable nodes
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue

        # Never remove a node whose symbol is required
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue

        # Never remove a node with retained children
        if any(child_id in retained for child_id in children[nid]):
            continue

        # Tentatively remove and check if required symbols remain represented
        retained.discard(nid)
        symbols_remaining = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)

        if all(sym in symbols_remaining for sym in required_symbols):
            # Removal is valid - keep it removed
            removal_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Restore - removal would violate required symbol constraint
            retained.add(nid)

    return {
        "retained_ids": sorted(retained),
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
```
